title: On Normalized Remainders in Maclaurin Series of Generating Function for Bernoulli Numbers
content: For \( m\in\mathbb{N} \)0, let \( h_m=T_{2m+1}\bigl[\frac{t}{e^t-1}\bigr] \) be the normalized remainders in the Maclaurin series of the generating function for the Bernoulli numbers. We show that \( h_m(t) \) is the convex combination of the functions \( \frac{(2\pi j)^2}{t^2+(2\pi j)^2} \) for \( j\in\mathbb{N} \) with the weights \( \frac{1}{j^{2m+2}\zeta(2m+2)} \). This partial-fraction expansion yields short proofs of the positivity of \( h_m \), the decreasing property of \( h_m \), and the increasing property of \( \frac{h_m}{h_{m+1}} \), which were established by Zhang, Yang, and Qi for \( m\in\mathbb{N} \) in [Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 153 (2025), 131–141], and extends them to \( m=0 \). It also yields three strengthenings: \( h_m(\sqrt{s}\,) \) and \( \frac{h_{m+1}(\sqrt{s}\,)}{h_m(\sqrt{s}\,)} \) are Stieltjes functions of \( s \), and \( h_m \) satisfies the exact shift law \( h_m=1-\nu_{m,1}t^2h_{m+1} \) with an explicit constant \( \nu_{m,1}>0 \). We prove that \( h_m \) is neither convex, nor concave, nor logarithmically convex, nor logarithmically concave on \( (0,\infty) \), confirming a guess of Zhang, Yang, and Qi. We show that \( -\ln h_m(\sqrt{s}\,) \) is a complete Bernstein function of s, and that the Maclaurin series of \( \ln h_m \) has radius of convergence \( 2\pi \) and coefficients alternating in sign. Finally, we prove that \( \frac{th_m'(t)}{h_m(t)} \) is strictly decreasing on \( (0,\infty) \) for all \( m\in\mathbb{N} \)0, that is, \( h_m \) is strictly geometrically concave, and that \( -t^2h_m'(t) \) is strictly geometrically concave on \( (0,\infty) \) for all \( m\in\mathbb{N} \). For \( m\in\{1,2\} \), these two proofs are completed by a computer-assisted certificate in exact rational arithmetic.
